title: sentilab-open-sealed/1
description: A sealed (private) proposal or check. ciphertext is the proposal note's bytes as an age v1 binary file (header line age-encryption.org/v1) to the manifest's X25519 recipient, in padded standard base64. There is no plaintext fallback field. The whole note stays within the 4096-byte note cap, so a sealed plaintext is smaller than a public note. The plaintext must carry a salt; its canonical hash is the retry identity. ciphertext_ref = sha256 of the decoded age file bytes.
